description: This file contains utility functions and classes for image processing, including reading images, preprocessing, applying transformations, resizing, and visual effects. It is part of the keras_retinanet utility module for image manipulation within an object detection project.

classes.name: TransformParameters
classes.description: A class encapsulating parameters for image transformation such as fill mode, interpolation method, and translation behavior.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a TransformParameters instance with default or specified transformation settings.

methods.name: cvBorderMode
methods.description: Returns the OpenCV border mode corresponding to the fill mode.

methods.name: cvInterpolation
methods.description: Returns the OpenCV interpolation flag corresponding to the specified interpolation method.

classes.name: VisualEffect
classes.description: A class representing visual effects parameters such as contrast, brightness, hue, and saturation adjustments, with a callable method to apply these effects on images.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the visual effect parameters.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Applies the visual effects to an input image.

methods.name: read_image_bgr(path)
methods.description: Reads an image from the specified path and converts it to BGR format.

methods.name: preprocess_image(x, mode='caffe')
methods.description: Preprocesses an image for model input by subtracting ImageNet means or scaling according to the mode.

methods.name: adjust_transform_for_image(transform, image, relative_translation)
methods.description: Adjusts a given transformation matrix to align with the image dimensions and optional relative translation.

methods.name: apply_transform(matrix, image, params)
methods.description: Applies an affine transformation matrix to an image using OpenCV's warpAffine.

methods.name: compute_resize_scale(image_shape, min_side=800, max_side=1333)
methods.description: Calculates a scale factor to resize an image so that its smallest side is at least min_side and the largest at most max_side.

methods.name: resize_image(img, min_side=800, max_side=1333)
methods.description: Resizes an image to meet specified minimum and maximum side constraints.

methods.name: random_visual_effect_generator( contrast_range=(0.9, 1.1), brightness_range=(-.1, .1), hue_range=(-0.05, 0.05), saturation_range=(0.95, 1.05) )
methods.description: Creates a generator yielding VisualEffect instances with randomly sampled parameters within specified ranges.

methods.name: adjust_contrast(image, factor)
methods.description: Adjusts the contrast of an image by scaling pixel differences from the mean.

methods.name: adjust_brightness(image, delta)
methods.description: Adjusts the brightness of an image by adding an offset to pixel values.

methods.name: adjust_hue(image, delta)
methods.description: Adjusts the hue component of an image in HSV color space.

methods.name: adjust_saturation(image, factor)
methods.description: Adjusts the saturation component of an image in HSV color space.
